_help: API Chat funnel rules. Edit, save, restart the bot (or the lab). Same file format for the bot (data/api_chat/config_rules.json) and the lab (cmd/apitest/config_rules.json).
_share_turn: bot reply number at which the snap is shared, by the stranger's interest (HOT = horny / very engaged, WARM = flirty / curious, COLD = normal / low). Smaller = earlier. If the stranger asks for the snap himself it is shared earlier.
_no_share_percent: out of 100 chats, this many NEVER get the snap (no hint, no handle): the bot chats normally for no_share_min..no_share_max replies and then leaves. 0 = share in every chat (highest ban risk).
_no_share_strict: false = in a no-snap chat the bot still gives the handle when the stranger asks for it himself (he asked, so it is not spam). true = decline even then ('dont rly use it lol').
_hint_percent: of the chats that DO share, this many % get a ghost hint first (snap_hint.txt, no handle): if the stranger bites (yes / snap? / add me) the handle follows next reply, if he ignores it the next reply shares anyway. The rest share directly.
